run_train_tasks_main: run the multi-task VILBERT training pipeline via argparse CLI with configurable tasks
evaluate_model_tasks: evaluate the trained VILBERT model on validation sets for each configured task
load_datasets_multitask: load training and validation datasets for multiple VILBERT tasks from configuration
load_losses_multitask: load loss functions for each configured multi-task learning objective
forward_models_train: run forward pass on VILBERT model for training with gradient computation
